in_sanskrit.name: करिष्मा
in_sanskrit.meaning: One who desires action or one who works with love
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit words 'kari' meaning 'work' or 'action' and 'shma' meaning 'desire' or 'love'

in_marathi.name: Karishmaa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Time, Beauty, and Destiny
in_marathi.long_meaning: Karishmaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit ‘Kari’ (do) and ‘Shma’ (desire), Karishmaa represents the divine power that creates, sustains, and ultimately destroys the universe. As the goddess of time, she is also believed to be the embodiment of beauty and destiny.
